messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Quick sync: planning Aurora region launch with KubeBerry SI. Need marketplace entitlements, cloud quotas, KMS setup, and legal signoff before we unblock public announcement.
Devon (Marketplace): Understood. Entitlement flow requires SKU manifest, anticipated RPS/QPS, and a sandbox test plan. Can someone share projected numbers and test owners?
Suresh (PartnerEng): Projected capacity: baseline 6x A100-equivalent nodes for steady state, 10-node burst pool (16 GPUs total). Expected steady QPS ~60, peak burst QPS ~210. p95 target ~180ms.
Joel (CloudOps): I'll submit quota increase with provider. Need exact SKU tokens and KMS alias to attach to request. Also confirm if private VPC endpoints are required for marketplace listing.
Suresh (PartnerEng): SKUs: kb.infer.a100, kb.infer.burst, kb.net.private-vpc. KMS: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/aurora/cryptoKeys/kubeberry-launch. Yes, private endpoints required for Private deployments.
Marta (Legal): Legal asks for: (1) draft joint announcement copy, (2) dataflow diagram showing customer data boundary for Private, (3) responsibility matrix for support tiers. Share Drive link and mark docs as "confidential - embargoed".
Liam (SI, KubeBerry): We'll prepare an ops playbook (runbook) and a small demo script for marketplace sandbox. Requesting staging API keys and a short SLA paragraph for the marketplace listing.
Nora (Infra-QA): QA will run a quick soak test on staging for 24hrs and a failover stress test. Need an automated test endpoint and test account keys. Also will validate fallback to quantized model under throttle.
Devon (Marketplace): Staging keys: will create scope=marketplace-sandbox, expires=2024-06-21. Send list of test emails. Also attaching a recommended entitlement JSON snippet for the marketplace team to consume:
```json
{"entitlement_name":"kb-aurora","skus":["kb.infer.a100","kb.infer.burst","kb.net.private-vpc"],"kms_alias":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/aurora/cryptoKeys/kubeberry-launch","fallback_policy":{"cpu_pct":80,"route_to":"kb-quantized-micro","scale_out":"+2"},"status":"pending_legal"}
```
Anna (Partnerships): Timeline: embargo lift targeted for Wed 2024-06-19 09:00 PDT. To hit that we need quotas approved and staging validation complete by Tue EOD.
Joel (CloudOps): Quota ticket opened: https://cloud.example.com/quotas/REQ-88213. Requested expedite and linked SKUs + KMS. Vendor partner ops looped in.
marketplace-bot: Created entitlement ticket ENT-202406-AURORA-2. Required: SKU proof, KMS access test, SI runbook, legal signoff, QA results.
Marta (Legal): I'll run initial review today. Send the announcement draft and a short customer data processing statement. We'll flag any compliance blockers.
Liam (SI, KubeBerry): We'll run failover stress on Thu in our staging; plan: 1) baseline 6 nodes, 2) ramp traffic to 250 QPS over 10m, 3) assert fallback to quantized in <30s when throttled. Need staging keys and sandbox endpoint.
Nora (Infra-QA): I'll create a small test harness and share results (latency, error rates, failover time). Will post artifacts to Drive and attach to ENT ticket.
Devon (Marketplace): Staging keys created and sent to Liam & Nora. Reminder: do not use production keys. Entitlement request draft is attached to ENT ticket.
Anna (Partnerships): Action items: Suresh - finalize SKU manifest + Drive updates; Joel - monitor quota ticket and confirm provider SLA; Marta - legal review of announcement and DPA snippet; Liam - SI runbook + staging tests; Nora - QA test results; Devon - finish ENT request and keep marketplace ops in the loop.
press-ops: Holding all PR activity until Anna confirms. We'll prepare embargoed media list and embargo logistics once legal signs off.
Suresh (PartnerEng): Manifest and test vectors uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/aurora-sandbox. Included a short checklist for the entitlement reviewers.
Joel (CloudOps): Provider responded asking for region capacity template and network peering diagram. Uploaded and tagged REQ-88213.
Marta (Legal): Initial review done; one ask to clarify customer PII handling for Private mode and to add an incident escalation contact. Please update doc.
Nora (Infra-QA): First smoke test passed. Failover test scheduled Thu 10:00 PDT. I'll post logs after completion.
Anna (Partnerships): Great progress. Update the ENT ticket when each task is resolved. I'll not sign off on PR until ENT shows status=active and quotas=approved. :thumbsup:
